Loaded: Table 5.5 comparison of MVR, TVR, VC, compression-resorption and absorption heat pumps for one 10 MW condenser-to-reboiler duty (COP, installed cost per kW heat in 2012 EUR, temperature limits from Table 5.6); MVR COP at 55 K lift (Sect. 6.3.3); single/double-effect absorption COP (Sect. 7.2.4); Hybrid Energy CRHP and CO2 transcritical installations (Tables 6.4-6.5, capacity and temperature only); the five Chapter 10 case studies (bioethanol VRC extractive DWC with TIC, TOC, energy and CO2 per t ethanol; refinery VC heat pump; CRHP, AHP and ejector heat pumps on distillation columns with energy per t feed derived from printed MW and kg/h).
